title: Merger of RFMD and TriQuint Is Now Complete, Qorvo™ Emerges as a New Leader in RF Solutions
主要内容: RF Micro Devices, Inc. and TriQuint Semiconductor, Inc. completed their merger to form Qorvo, a new leader in RF solutions. The merger is expected to achieve at least $150 million in cost synergies, with $75 million in annualized synergies exiting the first year after closing and an additional $7,500,000 exiting the second year. TriQuint shareholders will receive 1.675 shares of Qorvo, and RFMD shareholders will receive 1 share of Qorvo for each share held. The transaction is expected to be accretive to non-GAAP EPS in the first full fiscal year following the merger. Qorvo, formed by the merger of RFMD and TriQuint, has emerged as a new leader in RF solutions. The company has over 6,000 global employees and offers a broad portfolio of products and core technologies. Qorvo is certified under ISO9001, ISO 14001, and ISO/TS 16949 standards and is a DoD-accredited 'Trusted Source' for GaAs, GaN, and BAW products and services. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Qorvo.
